about: I’m an fresh graduate Informatics student at Universitas Udayana with a strong interest in web development. I enjoy building functional, responsive, and user-friendly web applications while continuously improving my skills in modern web technologies. Throughout my academic and personal projects, I have gained experience working with technologies such as React, Laravel, JavaScript, PHP, and Python. I also have experience developing an AI model as part of my final thesis, which gave me additional exposure to machine learning and model development. I’m passionate about learning new technologies, solving problems through code, and turning ideas into useful digital solutions.

experience.description: Completed an intensive 4-month Android development program through Instructor-Led Training (ILT) and hands-on learning, covering Android development from fundamental to intermediate levels. As the Project Manager for the capstone project, led a team of 7 members divided into 3 development teams, coordinating project planning, task distribution, and collaboration. Successfully developed a mood-tracking application integrated with AI to classify users' moods, combining Android development, backend integration, and AI-based mood classification into a unified application.

Joined the Engineering Division and supported a QA assigned to a team consisting of 5 developers and 1 QA across 5 sprint cycles. Under the QA's guidance, created and executed test cases and used JIRA to identify, reproduce, report, and document UI- and API-level bugs, including detailed reproduction steps to help developers understand and resolve issues. Developed an end-to-end automated testing suite using Cypress.js, automating more than 10 previously manual test cases for a healthcare application developed for Dinas Kesehatan Kabupaten Badung.

Participated in a hands-on Full-Stack Web Development training program at Sandatindo, an IT solutions company, focusing on building web applications using PHP Native, MySQL, and AJAX. Collaborated with a team of 3 interns to design, develop, and complete a web application as part of the training program, gaining practical experience in both frontend and backend development, database integration, and asynchronous data communication. Successfully completed the assigned project through effective teamwork, problem-solving, and task coordination.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
education.description: Completed a 4-year undergraduate program in Informatics with a focus on software development and machine learning. Actively contributed to the Engineering Division of the Student Innovation Centre (SIC), an organization focused on developing the skills and talents of Informatics students. Collaborated with 3 developers to develop and maintain the organization's official website, worked closely with the UI/UX team, and managed 4 SIC clubs to support student skill development. Throughout my studies, I focused on designing and developing web and mobile applications and conducting research in Machine Learning, particularly in Music Information Retrieval (MIR).

projects.description: This is a collection of personal projects I have worked on, along with selected projects developed as part of my university coursework. Some were created out of curiosity and personal interest, while others provided opportunities to apply and strengthen my technical skills. I hope you enjoy exploring them.

projects.title: ReyongSynth | 2026
projects.description: ReyongSynth is a research project focused on the synthesis of traditional Balinese Reyong instrument sounds using a Variational Autoencoder (VAE).

projects.title: Internconnect | 2025
projects.description: Internconnect was developed to digitize the internship monitoring process, which was previously largely manual. The system provides features for managing logbooks, daily activities, supervisor or mentor verification, monitoring and evaluation submissions, sharing logbooks with other users, profile management, role change requests, and online meetings.

projects.title: Deep Music | 2025
projects.description: Deep Music is a web-based application for music mood classification and music recommendation based on user mood, favorite genres, and favorite artists.

projects.title: Automatic Scheduling Using a Genetic Algorithm | 2025
projects.description: This project was developed as part of a university research assignment to evaluate the effectiveness of the Genetic Algorithm (GA) in solving the university course timetabling problem.

projects.title: E-Market Fish - Mobile Fishery Products Marketplace | 2025
projects.description: A mobile e-commerce application designed to help customers discover, browse, and order fresh and frozen fishery products. The application provides a simple and convenient shopping experience, from exploring products and managing a cart to placing orders and managing delivery information.

projects.title: Moodify | 2024
projects.description: Moodify is a journaling app that supports mental health through a holistic approach. It offers a private space for users to record their thoughts and emotions while keeping entries confidential. The app tracks moods, provides weekly insights, and helps users identify emotional patterns. Additional features include guided relaxation exercises, soothing sounds, mental health tips, and an interactive chatbot for personalized support, making Moodify a trusted companion for emotional well-being.

projects.title: Memospace: Management Activity | 2024
projects.description: Memospace is a web-based Management Activity designed to help students and lecturers manage their academic and campus activities more effectively.

projects.title: Sistem Persuratan | 2024
projects.description: The application helps users record, manage, and organize incoming and outgoing letters digitally, making correspondence management more efficient and structured, especially when handling a large number of documents.

projects.title: Hotel Management System: Receptionist Role | 2024
projects.description: This repository focuses specifically on the receptionist role and its related features. Other roles within the hotel management system are not implemented in this repository because they are developed separately by other team members.

projects.title: Library Book Borrowing System | 2024
projects.description: Library Book Borrowing System is a web-based application designed to digitize and simplify the book borrowing process in an offline library.

projects.title: AutoDeals - Car Dealership Management System | 2023
projects.description: AutoDeals is a desktop-based car dealership management system developed as an Object-Oriented Programming final project. The application is designed to support offline dealership operations by helping administrators, owners, and employees manage vehicle data, employee information, customer transactions, and payment records efficiently.

projects.title: Hotel Reservation Web Application | 2022
projects.description: DaHotel is a hotel reservation web application developed using Native PHP and MySQL as part of the final practical examination during vocational high school (SMK). The project was built to fulfill the requirements of creating a hotel reservation system with three user roles: Guest, Receptionist, and Administrator. The system focuses on online room reservations without implementing an online payment gateway, following the official UKK project specifications.

projects.title: Restaurant Service App | 2021
projects.description: The project aims to replace traditional printed menus with a digital ordering system. Customers can browse the menu, place orders directly through the web application, and submit their orders without waiting for a waiter. The cashier is responsible for managing incoming orders, processing transactions, and serving customers, simplifying restaurant operations through a centralized system.
